raw_response:
This rice plot is small, and I have to be careful with money, but I will still put some chemical fertilizer because rice responds to it and I want a better harvest. I will use improved seed if I can get it, and I will rely mostly on family work, with only a little hired help when the work is heavy. I do not plan to irrigate, because here I depend on the rains, and I am not likely to use pesticide on this plot.
